package pkg

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/demo/gen/typestest"
)

func TestAllowPasses(t *testing.T) {
	dir := fixture(t)
	if !Allow("lease", dir) {
		t.Fatal("want allow")
	}
}

func TestInnerWithMock(t *testing.T) {
	m := typestest.NewStore(t)
	if !Inner(m.Path()) {
		t.Error("want true")
	}
}

func fixture(t *testing.T) string {
	return t.TempDir()
}
